response.justification: The candidate is a skilled senior software engineer, but their experience is almost exclusively in web technologies, high-level application development (TypeScript, Node.js, Dlang), and microservices. This profile has a fundamental mismatch with the core requirements of the role, which demands strong C programming for embedded systems, deep knowledge of L2/L3 networking, specific security protocols, and Linux kernel expertise. Most critically, the candidate does not meet the mandatory requirement for native-level Japanese language proficiency.
strengths: Extensive experience as a senior/staff engineer in various modern tech stacks.
Proven ability to work with low-latency, high-performance systems.
Demonstrates strong initiative through founding projects, giving talks, and open-source contributions.
concerns: Lacks the mandatory native-level Japanese language proficiency.
No experience in the required domain of embedded networking firmware or LAN-switch products.
Minimal and very dated C/C++ experience; primary skills are in different languages.
